method: Read every source paragraph against English, including dialogue and working conditions.

findings.issue: 上下床 is a euphemistic reference to sexual relations, not upper/lower bunks.
findings.before: Freedom and licence, however, were only an upper and a lower bunk apart; in time, breaches of convention became common.
findings.after: The distinction between an open manner and loose morals, however, was little more than a matter of getting into bed; in time, breaches of convention became common.
